instrument: in-process time.perf_counter around one call, B4's percentile method; 50 rounds, each timing a block of 100 calls per surface per mode with the mode order rotating every round, after a discarded warm-up of 200 per cell; gc.collect() at the start of each round; one DurableEngine per mode over one scratch SQLite file (the platform Database, WAL), installed for its block only; the outbox loop not running, ticked between blocks outside the stopwatch so every held delivery is handed off; stand-in services, feed and attestation client that answer at once — the platform's own cost, no chain, no network. main_off: surface execute in mode off, serve_blocks() in two interpreters running at once, one importing a checkout of the base tree and one this tree, taking turns block by block (250 blocks of 100 each, the first of each turn alternating, gc.collect() every third block as a round collects), samples pooled per tree; ratio_this_tree_to_main compares those two, stretches and ratio_p95_per_stretch the same over 5 consecutive stretches of the run, and ratio_cell_off_to_main the in-process off cell (timed between shadow and on blocks, in the interpreter whose engines write) against the base tree. Not timed: pre_action, which no durable code runs in, and the HTTP route itself. Host-dependent: host gives the processor count and the load averages.

main_off.main_commit: Merge audit-remediation-2026-07: a public sentence says what the code does, and a test reads it against the code

measured.on_top_of: G6 times the mode off on both trees at once, taking turns block by block

rule: the latency engines.durable adds to one dispatch, in microseconds: for each surface, added = the mode's p50 (p95) minus mode off's p50 (p95), measured in the same rounds. A p95 difference is a difference of percentiles, not a percentile of per-call differences.
scope: execute: ServiceDispatcher.execute of every state-modifying ACTION_MAP name in turn (184), params {to, amount, marker}, the caller's identity bound, no Idempotency-Key. execute_keyed: the same inside wiring.keyed with a fresh Idempotency-Key per call (the bridge's sequence after the gate). tool_twin_signing: ToolDispatcher.dispatch('nft', {action: mint, ...}) as agent neo with a session identity. Every service answers a settled success at once; in shadow and on every dispatch writes one run (two transactions), and in on a settled execute also writes an attestation and a feed outbox row.
